value.answer: OAuth apps can now register up to 10 redirect URIs, making it easier to support multiple environments, domains, or deployment configurations without creating separate apps. Developers can add additional URLs to match against using the new Add redirect URI button in their application settings. OAuth apps can also opt in to expiring access tokens and refresh tokens, enhancing security.
